# Minimal integration into the existing Space app.py
#
# 1. Copy src/managed_compute_core.py, src/managed_space_endpoints.py and
#    src/managed_smoke.py into the Space repository root.
# 2. Import:
#       from managed_space_endpoints import attach_managed_endpoints
# 3. Inside the existing `with gr.Blocks() as demo:` construction, add:
#       attach_managed_endpoints()
# 4. Keep the existing `demo.queue().launch(...)` call.
#
# Do not launch a second Gradio app.
